answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 63313 Country: India Title: About washing impure clothes in washing machine. Question: I am working in Saudi Arabia so I stay in sharing where 5 peoples stay together. The question is that how to wash impure (napak) clothes in washing machine like if I get ihtalam and my clothes get dirty so I first take a bucket of water and rinse it in once and then put it in washing machine tub with surf detergent then after it has washed for 30 minutes I drain the water and remove the clothes from the washing tub and put it in the next tub which is for drying clothes then there it is dried for 5 minutes and again I pour a clean water in washing tub and put it again and make it wash in clean water for 10 minutes then again I put it for drying so my clothes will be pure or any easy way to wash please guide me. Answer ID: 63313 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 203/203/SD=04/1437) Yes, your clothes shall turn pure if washed as per the above mentioned method in washing machine. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
